entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return a product.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just... confusing. I find it really hard to use.
I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Many of the advanced features are detailed in the user manual. Have you had a chance to look through that?
I glanced at it. Honestly, I expected more from it out of the box. It shouldn't be this complicated. I just want to send it back.
I understand. Not every device is the right fit for everyone. Let me just check our return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for holding, Sarah. I've checked the policy, and since your item was delivered 19 days ago, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you now.

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just pack the item back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the email comes through.
It has been sent. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
